agent_explanation: Shrunk case is a single body with e=1 starting just below ceiling (y=11.6, r~0.30, ceiling at 12) moving upward at ~40 m/s with dt~0.0287. It hits ceiling within step 1, triggering many substeps (40+). After bounce, |vy| grows from 40.47 to 40.73 to 42.42 to 44.12, faster than gravity alone (g*dt~0.28). Mechanical energy rises from E0=971.9 to 973.0 to 1031.7 to 1092.7 at step 3, exceeding allowed E0*1.1+5=1074.16. Likely cause: restitution=1 collision with implicit arena boundary plus positional correction injects energy when resolved inside substeps, compounding each step. Lowering e to 0 removes bounce energy injection.
